how_to_use: Paste prompt_text into your image tool, or feed the structured prompt block if the tool accepts JSON.
Attach the listed product posters as reference images so the product shapes stay true.
Generate 4 variants per prompt, then pick the cleanest one.
All text (headlines, buttons) is added in code. Keep the text_safe_area empty.
Export as WebP or AVIF, under 300 KB for hero, under 120 KB for tiles.
